issue.title: Vault git tracks the deployed bob-articles plugin files because .gitignore omits .obsidian/plugins/bob-articles/

task_type_fields.impact: Each host's bob plugins sync of bob-articles becomes a vault commit that other hosts pull, so one host's deploy overwrites another's plugin files out of band; it also contradicts the obsidian.md memory claim that custom bob-* plugins are gitignored. Fix carefully: git rm --cached on one host deletes the files on the others at their next pull, so redeploy with bob plugins sync on each host (or ignore first and untrack in a coordinated step).
task_type_fields.repro: In the vault: `git check-ignore -v .obsidian/plugins/bob-articles/main.js` prints nothing, and `git ls-files .obsidian/plugins/bob-articles` lists main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css (committed by vault-sync, e.g. e6be603e and 4276bc93 on 2026-10-16). The same block ignores block-id-prompt, bob-ledger-tools, bob-navigation-hotkeys, bob-project-tasks, bob-vim-surround, and task-status-cycler. Its comment also names the stale source path ~/projects/github/bbugyi200/bob-plugins (now bobs-org).

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning the bob-command-mode plugin: the vault .gitignore lists each custom plugin folder by name, and bob-articles was never added, so vault-sync commits every per-host plugins sync.

payload.description: The incident this feature prevents recurring: bob-articles was hand-omitted from the vault custom-plugin ignore block
